rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something quietly without making noise.

example.english: I walked silently into the room so I wouldn't wake Mum.
example.traditional: 靜靜咁行入房，唔好嘈醒阿媽。
example.jyutping: zing6 zing6 gam3 haang4 jap6 fong2 m4 hou2 cou4 seng2 aa3 maa1

rows.note: Use this when someone acts silently and discreetly so as not to attract attention.

example.english: They slipped the document away silently so nobody would see.
example.traditional: 靜雞雞咁拎走份文件，唔好畀人見到。
example.jyutping: zing6 gai1 gai1 gam3 ling1 zau2 fan6 man4 gin6 m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 gin3 dou2

rows.note: Use this for something happening with absolutely no sound, often also suggesting that nobody notices it.

example.english: The shop shut down silently, and nobody noticed.
example.traditional: 間舖頭無聲無息咁執咗笠，冇人留意。
example.jyutping: gaan1 pou3 tau4 mou4 sing1 mou4 sik1 gam3 zap1 zo2 lap6 mou5 jan4 lau4 ji3

rows.note: Use this when someone does something silently without speaking, commenting, or drawing attention to their feelings.

example.english: I silently supported them for years and never said a word.
example.traditional: 我默默咁支持佢多年，從來冇出聲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mak6 mak6 gam3 zi1 ci4 keoi5 do1 nin4 cung4 loi4 mou5 ceot1 seng1
